_about: Revision 4 of journey-routes, written on 2026-10-25 and not yet pushed (a --prod --dry-run against skku_content, which stores revision 3, passed; skku_content_dev refuses its 7800 rides as it refused revision 3's, while bus_campus_dev stores no 7800 registry route): revision 3 with rough real-world numbers from Naver Map transit directions (owner rule, 2026-10-25), read in a browser through aside: the walks 인사캠 정문↔혜화 and 사당 → 사당역9번출구앞 now include the walk inside the station (each with Naver's walk geometry as its path, rounded to six decimals), and the two 7800 rides carry ride minutes by the board's KST time of day (rideMinutesBands, needing a server that reads them) from Naver per-stop schedules sampled through a weekday and a weekend; every other leg is revision 3's.
